title: Follow Selection mode doesn't follow mouse movements exactly
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.beta5.official [bbd3f43b5]

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta5 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7260) - AMD Ryzen 7 6800H with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 23.26 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When using the new `Follow Selection` Mode (introduced in #99499) with a mouse, the translate operation doesn't follow the cursor exactly, accumulating an offset as long as the mouse button is held. The translation feels laggy, continuing in one direction when the cursor goes on another. This tool is very imprecise.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6b816da7-3c77-4c3a-9392-9494e6816cd4

The feature is cool and I get that adding a damping is even cooler for when the camera follows a constantly moving node. But damping the translation when moving with the mouse is unusable. **The translation operation should be exactly what the cursor moved by since last frame**.

### Steps to reproduce

On a new project on 4.7:
1. Create a scene with a `MeshInstance3D` using a `BoxMesh`
2. Select it and double-tap `F` to enter `Follow Selection Mode`
3. Move the Node with either the Transform Mode (Q) or the Move Mode (W), don't release the drag operation
4. Observe a lag between your cursor and the gizmo
